scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && bash -c 'set -e; if [ -d dist/scripts/scripts ]; then mkdir -p dist/scripts.tmp/semver; cp dist/scripts/scripts/*.js dist/scripts.tmp/; cp dist/scripts/semver/*.js dist/scripts.tmp/semver/; rm -rf dist/scripts; mv dist/scripts.tmp dist/scripts; sed -i "s|from \"../semver/semverRange.js\"|from \"./semver/semverRange.js\"|g" dist/scripts/resolve-version.js; fi' && mkdir -p dist/db/migrations dist/prompts dist/.pi && cp -r src/db/migrations/. dist/db/migrations/ && cp -r prompts/. dist/prompts/ && cp -r .pi/. dist/.pi/
